gen-nixie-one-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Nostalgic and a little retro-tech, Nixie One draws open curves with gaps and a constant stroke throughout. Tsukimi Rounded follows, soft and parallel-edged.
gen-nixie-one-gf-varela: Nostalgic in a retro-tech way, Nixie One keeps its curves open with clear gaps, while Varela has a t with crossbar and stem sharing one width. One leans display, the other modern and approachable.
gen-nixie-one-gf-vazirmatn: A stroke with no thick-and-thin modulation at all defines Nixie One, drawn in open curves with clear gaps. It handles headings, while Vazirmatn keeps its wide-open s approachable.
gen-nixie-one-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text brings open terminals that are easy to read, with a contemporary, professional feel. Nixie One sits above it with curves that never thin, a retro-tech counterweight.
gen-nixie-one-gf-ysabeau-sc: Ysabeau SC is a modern sans-serif with a visibly gaping c, and it stays readable at any size. Nixie One, with diagonals matching its stems, is best kept big and short.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zalando-sans: Nixie One looks nostalgic and retro-tech, its strokes traced as if with a marker through open curves. And Zalando Sans follows with an approachable, open-ended look on every curved letter.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antique: Zen Kaku Gothic Antique reads clean and modern, with smooth paths around each bend. Nixie One, nostalgic and retro-tech with open curves, makes a good display line, so give it generous size.
gen-nixie-one-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Nixie One opens with a nostalgic, retro-tech look, its curves gapped and its stroke constant from top to baseline. Zen Maru Gothic then carries the text, so reading feels like following a single thread.
gen-orbitron-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Orbitron spreads minimal, precise letters far apart along the line, each e given a clear, large eye. Pilcrow Rounded packs in tighter, warm and with curves that refuse to close.
gen-orbitron-fs-roundo: Roundo keeps a geometric feel, its n built with matching arch and stem. Orbitron stretches wide above it, precise and minimal, while Roundo's lowercase stays moderate against its high one.
